title: 卡库亚针问题的最小转向区域
posterTitle: 单位线段可以在任意小面积内转向
posterHook: 最笨的办法是原地转一圈；更聪明的办法是贴着一条三尖形轨道滑过去。答案是：地方可以几乎为零——但再小也不能瘪成一条线。
question: 桌上有一根针要掉头，最少需要多大一块地方？

en.title: The minimum turning region in the Kakeya needle problem
en.posterTitle: A unit segment can turn inside a region of arbitrarily small area
en.posterHook: The clumsy way is to spin in place; a smarter way is to slide along a three-cusped track. The area can shrink to almost nothing—but it still cannot flatten into a single line.
en.question: A needle on a table needs to turn around—how little room does it need?
